blind.description: An ornate classical architectural corbel or wall bracket made of carved sandstone or limestone. It features a flat rectangular molded top ledge supported by an S-curved console decorated with sculpted acanthus leaves, scroll volutes on the sides, and a flat vertical back. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and fully textured with natural stone shading.
blind.from_above: A simple flat rectangular tan stone slab with beveled edges, with slight decorative lips extending beneath the bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-fourth the height of the figure (roughly 1.5 feet / 45 cm tall), and about 1 foot wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.46x off the catalog (0.8 x 0.8 ft)
